headline: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña Removed and Charged Over Bank Collapse
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was impeached by the Senate, placed under house arrest, and charged by prosecutors with two crimes linked to the collapse of a state-affiliated bank.
why: Political crises and the collapse of financial institutions can severely destabilize emerging-market economies and sovereign debt.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Presidential impeachment and banking crisis create domestic economic and political instability.
